unsealed.point: Live pointer and keyboard gesture interception (capture at pointer-down or direct-edit start, preview geometry, interception before the upstream commit or the measured restore fallback) and the browser witnesses DI-only drag, resize, reconnect, palette drop, direct edit, keyboard delete/paste, cancellation during async layout, multi-page rollback, one undo/redo and no callback leak; and a native modeling command (a command-stack entry such as element.updateLabel) arriving while the root transaction is applying.
unsealed.default: Detached staging, one root profile.transaction command, final-only callbacks; an entry that cannot preserve pointer capture, selection, undo cursor and DI is disabled with transaction-entry-unsupported. No accepted lot-0 prototype or receipt exists at the seal base: only the programmatic contract (l3-tx-*) is sealed, and a gesture's final intent enters through the stageGesture adapter seam. DESIGN L635 refuses any unexpected command entry during applying with transaction-reentrant and disables unadapted mutation commands, but the headless canvas has no native modeling service and no caller-visible outcome of a refused native command is defined before the prototype receipt: l3-tx-reentrant-refused seals the public applyCommands re-entry only.

unsealed.point: Activated N support creation in business-profile editing once both gates pass (owner ratified, conductor plus twin atomicity proof pending).
unsealed.default: Until both gates pass, an N ensure that would create a support refuses profile-open in edit activation (sealed: l3-n-full-edit, l3-n-hash-shaped-occupant-edit, l3-n-recreate-after-remap-edit); neutral qualification proceeds (sealed qualification vectors). The activated editing behavior is not sealed.

unsealed.point: Creation of an external call (palette or AI), migration of legacy external markers to the discriminator, and the activated external branch of N in editing.
unsealed.default: One dedicated native Documentation marker, absence means incomplete; external creation and migration stay unavailable until both libraries prove the encoding and the effective base admits CallActivity.documentation with a conditional calledElement. Sealed: recognition and the N external branch as qualification vectors with the neutral marker, and the edit refusal l3-n-imported-supports-edit (profile-open). The profile has no external creation entry.

unsealed.point: Removal of a conflicting business-lane membership once an accepted persisted representation of the original responsibility or an approved concrete loss exists, and the explicit bulk name synchronization command.
unsealed.default: Preserve original memberships: qualification refuses responsibility-preservation-required (l3-n-business-lane-refusal), edit refuses profile-open (l3-n-business-lane-refusal-edit); never synchronize divergent reference names during N (l3-n-two-processes). The permitted removal and the bulk command are not sealed.

unsealed.point: Production activation of the missing-output-source producer exception and any completion that would remove or weaken a producer restriction.
unsealed.default: Preserve every valid port and set; the main profile has no output-port authority (l3-c-input-ports leaves DOA_1 unported); the variant expressing the authority refuses profile-open in edit (l3-c-output-port-gated) and creates the keyed port only in qualification (l3-c-output-port-qualification). Activation needs the owner's approval of the precise change.

unsealed.point: External-producer substitution (an Association from an external call to a Process DataOutput), the activity-only producer restriction, the acceptance status of documents depending on them, and N's or validate's handling of that candidate link.
unsealed.default: Retain every evidenced supplier/consumer link with its direction, invent no endpoint, keep the substitution and the activity-only rule gated, refuse affected final acceptance with profile-open while unresolved. The link-endpoint rule never reports the candidate pair, no sealed vector contains it, and N has no reversal recipe for it.

unsealed.point: The stricter immediate named-branch convention (start event followed directly by an exclusive gateway with named outgoing flows) and any acceptance status that depends on adopting it.
unsealed.default: Ratified default: a source-backed downstream exclusive branch, no invented adjacency or choice text, no gateway created by N; the strict candidate stays disabled until expressly adopted (sealed: l3-trig-downstream-branch-accept accepts a non-adjacent branch).

unsealed.point: Every concrete behavior-changing or lossy migration: legacy evidence adapters (process-reference metadata, text markers, placement metadata, support labels) and the approval of a specific ID remap of accepted data.
unsealed.default: Evidence-based classification, complete loss and remap report, retained ambiguous source snapshot, activation refuses rather than discarding. Sealed: remap mechanics with an explicit approval record and the OPEN-ID gate (l3-imp-remap-*), legacy markers never classifying (l3-n-legacy-marker-ignored); no legacy adapter is sealed.

unsealed.point: Owner restrictions on already accepted persisted data, the activated binding transaction in editing once the gates pass, and the persisted-loss policy for retained black-box participants the base does not permit.
